title: Kremlin: Greetings to President of China Xi Jinping
summary:
Vladimir Putin sent a message of greetings to President of the People’s Republic of China Xi Jinping
on the 77 th anniversary of the founding of the PRC.

title: Kremlin: Greetings on Ground Forces Day
summary:
The President sent greetings to the current personnel and veterans of Russia’s
Ground Forces on their professional holiday.
